mapper.select: SELECT pep.id, pep.prescription_name, p.name as patient_name, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) as age, p.birth_date, p.medical_record_no as medical_record_number, p.disease_type, p.enrollment_institution, pep.execution_institution, pep.prescription_status, pep.prescribing_doctor, pep.created_time, pep.updated_time FROM patient_exercise_prescription pep LEFT JOIN patient p ON pep.patient_id = p.id WHERE pep.id = #{id}
